name: Edo Ranze ~Come on! Mito Hime-sama~
original_name: エドランゼ ～Come on!水戸姫様～
source:
Shogun Tokugawa Masamune starts reforms, but it also gives way to criminals of all sorts, and Edo gets drowned in crime. A hunt for criminals with huge prize is announced while Shogun goes to hot springs. Mito princess is left in Edo, so she is a tempting target for all sorts of warring parties snooping around.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-october-2008-volume-7.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
征夷大将军德川政宗大刀阔斧推行新政，却也让各路不法之徒钻了空子，繁华江户城一时间治安败坏、罪案丛生。趁将军动身前往温泉乡疗养之际，幕府贴出巨额悬赏令缉拿各路恶徒；而独自留守江户城内的水户公主，顿时成了暗中觊觎的各方势力眼中最肥美诱人的猎物。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-october-2008-volume-7.html]vndbreview[/url]]
